node_definition.done_when:
Make a production pick fit its 5 s bound by removing the two in-bound costs that the pick-latency census measured. The census report is ~/.config/reckon/crew/reports/reckon/pick-latency-census/report.md; read it first. Its measuring driver is in the same directory, measure_pick_stages.py.

1. snapshot.candidates (reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py) scans the ledger rows twice per configured backend on every pick: once in recent_outcomes (line 40) and once in _peak_input_utilisation (line 105). It also reads each lane document per backend in _lane (line 178), the third reader of a document that run_time_profile.local_lane_load() already reads. Make it one pass over the records, keyed by backend and model, that yields both the outcome counts and the peak-utilisation values. Read each lane document once per pick, through run_time_profile.local_lane_load rather than a separate reader in snapshot.py. Every candidate field must be unchanged: same counts, same peaks, same lane facts.
2. estimated_context_tokens (reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py line 70) takes 7.7 s on a cold process, because it re-counts all standing-instruction files. Cache the census with the file stamps it was built from, and recount only a file whose stamp has changed. The census lives in reckon/crew/routing.py. The figures must equal an uncached census of the same files.
3. Tests in tests/test_pick_candidates_one_pass.py:
   - Equality: candidates() output is identical between the one-pass implementation and the per-backend reference for a multi-backend ledger fixture. Compute the reference in the test from the same fixture.
   - Scan count: the record list is iterated once per pick, counted with an instrumented iterable.
   - Census cache: the second census of unchanged files reads none of them, and a touched file is recounted.
4. Re-run the census driver against the head tree, cold and warm, and record the per-stage median and maximum. The snapshot_candidates median must fall and must not exceed the base figure at any percentile. Name the before and after figures in the manifest.

Do not edit reckon/crew/dispatch.py or reckon/cli.py; they are on hold for a module split. Gate: tests/test_pick_candidates_one_pass.py, every tests/test_picker*.py, tests/test_jev_weighs_context.py, tests/test_dispatch_context_estimate_is_one_figure.py, and every tests/ file that imports reckon.crew.routing. Run with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 in the FOREGROUND, with one log each for base and head under the run directory, each ending in an EXIT line, judged by delta. Write the evidence fragment docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/pick-candidates-one-pass.html.
node_definition.goal: A production pick scans the ledger once and reuses its instruction census, so it fits its 5 s bound
